items.title: Australian run of Waitress closing early with Sydney shows cancelled
items.description: The Australian stage production of Waitress will no longer continue on its national tour, with planned shows in Sydney now cancelled.

items.title: Live: Piastri makes early gain, driver claims he has 'fire in my car'
items.description: Oscar Piastri starts tonight's Austrian Grand Prix from seventh on the grid, as Mercedes and Ferrari are at the head of the field. Follow live.

items.title: Major capital cities record worst housing auction clearance rates in years
items.description: Sydney and Melbourne record their weakest auction results in years, with fewer than half of all homes going under the hammer finding a buyer.

items.title: If the UK has become ungovernable, some people say Brexit is to blame
items.description: It took only a month after coming to office for Keir Starmer's popularity to begin plummeting. Does it mean the UK has become ungovernable? Or is something else to blame?

items.title: Treasurer promises to 'fix' property tax oversight, but won't say how exactly
items.description: The Treasurer is promising to "fix" an unintended consequence of the government's overhaul of property tax breaks to protect widows and divorcees — but he has refused to say exactly how.

items.title: What happened when the ABC went to uncover Bali's 'Island of Trash'
items.description: Known to many as the Island of the Gods, residents fear Bali may soon become the "Island of Trash" due to a deluge of tourists, a lack of rubbish education and the partial closure of a much-needed landfill facility.

items.title: Thai teenager's father 'deeply saddened' over her death as Australian man charged with murder
items.description: The family of a 17-year-old girl in Thailand speak of their grief as an Australian man is charged with her murder.

items.title: US strikes Iran, Iran hits Bahrain and Kuwait as Middle East tensions escalate
items.description: The United States and Iran have exchanged strikes against targets in the Middle East, underscoring rising tensions that threaten the interim deal between the two nations to stop the war.

items.title: Hanson spawned the silliest semantic beard-stroking in 20 years
items.description: We've come a long way since it was Pauline Hanson who didn't know the meaning of big words.

items.title: Footy's quiet crisis claims its youngest victim
items.description: A talent and a team player, Nick Lowden excelled at Aussie Rules. But the knocks, bumps, hits and collisions were adding up.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
